title: Records Punch made with various bandleaders
summary: Punch lists records with Al Wynn, Francois Luzan, Jimmy Wade, Tiny Parham and his own band.

story.theme_name: Chicago: the jazz migration and its clubs
story.community_name: Going north: working the Chicago jazz scene

blocks.x: Did you all make any records together?
No, I never made no record with him. I don't believe.

He was on, he might have played bass on some of them records I made, I don't know, because I was with him right now. But I'll tell you the band, I made records with me and Al Wynn, then I made records with Francois Luzan, I made records with Jimmy Weed, I made records with Tiny Palm, then I made some of my own, you know, with a bunch I had. Somebody else I made records with, I can't think, no. I made records with a lot of guys.
I was just thinking about Tiny Palm, did you ever play any of his arrangements?
